# Titulo 1

## Subtitulo 2

```{python}
import altair as alt
from vega_datasets import data
cars = data.cars() 
print(cars.head()) 
```

## Visualización en Altar

### Visualización scatterplot

```{python}

chart1 = alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x="Miles_per_Gallon",
    y="Horsepower",
    tooltip=["Name","Origin","Miles_per_Gallon","Horsepower"]
).interactive()

chart1

```

### Visualización scaterplot con color

```{python}

chart2 = alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x="Miles_per_Gallon",
    y="Horsepower",
    color="Origin",
    tooltip=["Name","Origin","Miles_per_Gallon","Horsepower"]
).interactive()
chart2

```

### Agregaciones

Gráfico de barras

`count()` de cada una de los origines
```{python}
alt.Chart(cars).mark_bar().encode(
    alt.X('Origin',sort='-y'),
    alt.Y('count()')
)

```

`mean()` de cada una de los origines

```{python}
alt.Chart(cars).mark_bar().encode(
    alt.X('Origin',sort='-y'),
    alt.Y('mean(Weight_in_lbs)'),
    tooltip=['Origin','mean(Weight_in_lbs)']
).properties(
    width=200,
    height=200
)
```

Gráfico lineal

```{python}
alt.Chart(cars).mark_line(point=True).encode(
    alt.X('Year'),
    alt.Y('mean(Weight_in_lbs)'),
    alt.Color('Origin')
).properties(
    width=600
).interactive()
```
